column1: # Obligation citations — goal 0009a (freeze the native oracle), the machine-checked half of the
# increment's acceptance surface (docs/goals/0009a-native-oracle.md).
# **What a row here is, exactly.** This increment makes no Go change (its Bounds), so it adds no Go test;
# docs/conventions.md still holds a citations row to be one *gate-runnable Go test* in a package
# scripts/gate-targets.txt covers. Every row below therefore names one **oracle rule** — the rule ids are
# `scripts/codex-native-check.py`'s `ORACLE_RULES` keys — and the existing Go test that already pins the
# same claim about this tree's own bytes: the sentence the rule restates, true of the writer today and
# re-derived by this step when the gate runs. Where the rule states more than one clause, the `artifact`
# cell names the clause the cited test pins, and the row is no claim of conjunct-level coverage of the
# whole sentence. A row makes no claim that a Go test runs the oracle.
# The oracle's own firing is re-derived by the required `selftest` step instead:
# `scripts/tests/test_codex_native_check.py`'s `CodexArtifactOracle` holds the rule table and its mutation
# table in bijection — every rule has at least one committed synthetic fixture whose mutation turns that
# rule red and no other, and a mutation without a rule fails too
# (`test_every_rule_has_a_mutation_that_turns_its_fixture_red`, the increment's D1). The fixtures are
# `scripts/tests/testdata/codex-oracle/` (the three synthetic artifacts, their manifest receipts).
# Deliberately not covered, with the reason (form-based: a row is one Go test in a package
# scripts/gate-targets.txt covers, so a rule whose gate re-derivation is a python case the required
# `selftest` step runs, or a native harness run, cannot hold one):
#   oracle.receipt, oracle.plan-emitted, oracle.plan-accounted, oracle.plan-order, oracle.plan-pairs —
#         the manifest-receipt half (22 of the shipped corpus's 68 fixture pairs). No Go test grounds it,
#         because nothing in this tree produces a receipt yet: the receipt's producer is goal
#         0009c/0009d (this goal's Non-scope), and the rules are stated over the synthetic receipts
#         committed with the fixtures. Their re-derivation is the same `selftest` case's mutation table
#         — `--selftest-mutations` executes it, on every arm through the shipped command's own
#         `--validate`/`--receipt`/`--disable-rule` path, and the case's bijection asserts it from both
#         ends (four mutations for `oracle.receipt`, two for `oracle.plan-emitted`, thirteen for
#         `oracle.plan-accounted`, two for `oracle.plan-order` and one for `oracle.plan-pairs`) —
#         beside the surviving corpus cases:
#         `test_a_receipt_that_declares_nothing_cannot_pass` (the plan is total: an empty receipt is
#         refused before comparison, a metadata-only artifact included),
#         `test_a_result_substituted_under_one_call_id_is_refused` and
#         `test_a_call_substituted_under_one_call_id_is_refused` (a result's identity is its call and
#         its recorded text, a call's its call id, name and recorded input — a same-id substitution of
#         either is refused), `test_a_custom_calls_recorded_input_is_part_of_its_identity` (a
#         `custom_tool_call`'s recorded input lives in `input`, and the receipt's `arguments` member
#         names it there), `test_a_written_empty_object_input_is_part_of_the_identity` (the identity is
#         the member the artifact writes — the writer's own `arguments: "{}"` is not the read's empty
#         answer — its both-members arm among the refusals below),
#         `test_a_valid_content_item_array_output_is_refused_with_a_plan` (a result's `output` written
#         as a typed content-item array is natively decodable and refused where a plan is compared,
#         because the receipt's recorded-text identity is a string),
#         `test_a_native_media_block_is_accepted_and_refused_with_a_plan` (a well-formed `input_image`
#         beside a message's text is structurally green and refused where a plan is compared, because
#         the receipt names a message by its role and its text),
#         `test_a_rollback_event_is_refused_with_a_plan` (an appended `thread_rolled_back` event,
#         whose replay drops recorded turns, is refused where a plan is compared; without one it is a
#         native record),
#         `test_a_boundarys_replacement_history_is_refused_with_a_plan` (a boundary carrying a native
#         `replacement_history` is refused where a plan is compared),
#         `test_a_retained_checkpoint_or_record_is_refused_with_a_plan` (a boundary's `retained_context`
#         checkpoint and a `retained_context`/`inter_agent_communication`/`realtime_item` record — the
#         vocabulary's dialogue-bearing types — are refused where a plan is compared, an empty
#         checkpoint member the green control),
#         `test_a_boundary_without_a_string_summary_is_refused_in_both_modes` (a boundary whose
#         `message` member is absent or not a string is refused without a receipt, and a plan naming
#         the empty text cannot certify it; the explicit empty string is the valid empty summary and
#         the green control; the counting half is
#         `test_a_boundary_with_an_explicit_empty_summary_is_counted`),
#         `test_a_message_role_outside_the_receipts_vocabulary_is_refused_with_a_plan` (a
#         `response_item` `message` in a role outside the receipt's vocabulary is refused where a plan
#         is compared, so the plan's omitted prompt cannot survive as a role the vocabulary skips),
#         `test_a_forked_session_is_refused_with_a_plan` (a `session_meta` carrying `forked_from_id` is
#         refused where a plan is compared; a blank member is the green control),
#         `test_a_call_without_a_usable_name_is_no_call` (a call whose `name` is not the non-empty
#         string the carried reader registers is refused with its orphaned output),
#         `test_a_moved_turn_context_is_outside_the_receipts_vocabulary` (a record's turn placement is
#         outside what the receipt states and the rule's sentence says so, the finding's own
#         `turn_context` move validating green), `test_occurrence_identity_is_counted_not_deduplicated`
#         (multiplicity is identity-counted),
#         `test_the_corpus_arms_run_the_shipped_command_not_the_python_validator` (every arm of every
#         pair is read through the shipped command's `--validate`/`--disable-rule` path, so the flag is
#         exercised for every declared rule rather than only the one a CLI case names), and the
#         structural refusals a plan comparison reaches — `test_a_line_with_a_duplicate_member_is_refused`,
#         `test_a_member_the_native_decoder_refuses_is_refused_alone`,
#         `test_a_lone_surrogate_escape_is_refused_before_any_identity_comparison` — beside their own
#         rows and mutations above.
#   the oracle's `--validate` mode — the CLI half of the same python subject
#         (`test_the_validate_mode_reports_a_verdict`, and
#         `test_decoded_input_never_aborts_validation`: a decoded string strict UTF-8 cannot encode and a
#         string member nested past Python's parser each end in the documented verdict and exit code
#         rather than a traceback); no native-or-Go half exists for it.
#   D1 — every rule has its own negative fixture: the `selftest` case named above.
#   D2 — the oracle needs no knowledge of the source or the selection: the same case's
#         `test_a_reduced_artifact_is_validated_from_the_artifact_alone` drives the validator with
#         `builtins.open`, `io.open` and `os.open` (the names `pathlib`'s reads resolve among them)
#         refusing every file — and shows each refusal fires — and §2 of
#         docs/evidence/0009a-native-oracle.md validates the reduced fixture from a scratch directory
#         that holds nothing else.
#   D3 — the existing acceptance path is unchanged: `scripts/codex-native-check.py`'s own unflagged run is
#         a native harness run, not a gate step; its before/after verdicts are quoted in §3 of the record
#         (26 check(s) passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped, exit 0, both times) and the acceptance path itself is a
#         Go suite the `test` step already runs.
#   D4 — the freeze is stated where a later lane reads it: prose in the checker's own oracle section,
#         docs/harness.md and AGENTS.md; the oracle-lock signal that enforces it is the conductor's, not a
#         command in this tree.

column4: 0009a-native-oracle.md §1 (the writer's own bytes: every line decodes as one JSON object — the case decodes every line and fails one that is not, a `null` included, because the emptied line then carries no type; the member-name-uniqueness clause of the rule is pinned by the `selftest` mutation `a line holding a member name twice` and `test_a_line_with_a_duplicate_member_is_refused`, and its unpaired-surrogate clause by the mutation `two call ids distinct to Python and one to the read` and `test_a_lone_surrogate_escape_is_refused_before_any_identity_comparison`, not by this Go test)
